server.title: Mimiq: AI agents use your app like your users and find what breaks
server.description: AI agents use your app like your users, in real browsers, and report what is broken or confusing.

serverInfo.name: mimiq
serverInfo.description: AI agents use your web app like your users, each in a real browser, and report what is broken, what did nothing and where they got stuck, with the step and a screenshot. Run it on a preview before you ship, and after each fix.
